'''Paria''' was a female [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Paria also provided the knowledge of [[Synthweave|synthweaving]] to others. She wore [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] and carried a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].
